sql: SELECT to_regclass('public.incentive_balance_observations') IS NOT NULL AS table_exists, coalesce((SELECT count(*)::text FROM incentive_balance_observations),'0') AS rows, coalesce((SELECT max(at)::text FROM incentive_balance_observations),'-') AS newest, coalesce((SELECT sum(residual_cents)::text FROM incentive_balance_observations WHERE presumed_transfer IS NOT TRUE),'-') AS residual_cents_total
